messages.subject: can not install ggplot2 on Ubuntu 12.04(64bit)
parts:
I switched to Linux recently. I was able to install R which is the newest version 3.0.1. However, I couldn't install ggplot2 package. I used to run R on Windows without any problems. The error is as followings. Do I need to install an older R version(older than 3.0.0)? Any suggestions would be helpful. Thanks

** R

* removing ‘/home/alex/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0/scales’

Alex:

The log shows that ggplot2 installation failed because:

1. 'codetools' have to be reinstalled. You may use:
update.packages(checkBuilt=TRUE)

2. 'scales' was not on you library:
install.packages('scales')

Now, you may try again.
